verdict.rationale: Navan's pricing page says it can 'manage expenses and issue reimbursements', and its API covers repayments and payroll. Nothing in the pack addresses paying employees abroad in their local currency, multi-currency payouts, or avoiding a separate international payments process, so only the generic reimbursement half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: local-currency/multi-currency reimbursement payouts, international employee payout coverage, evidence that no separate international payments process is needed, independent corroboration.
